The '''Imperial Plaza''' was a broad ground-level circle made of [[Ferrocrete/Legends|ferroconcrete]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was where crowds of spectators gathered to witness the arrival of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] after their successful [[Battle of Thyferra|liberation]] of the planet [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]].<ref name="WS" />
